rationale: Builds on the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline with a compact structural change: split recurrence curriculum into separate carry and block-delta gains, so deep tail blocks start by refreshing toward the decoder-output anchor before their recurrent block update fully ramps in. This targets the local anchor-refresh signal without adding new large tensors, keeps compile shapes stable by using a fixed 2xN gain tensor, and preserves the quant-aware/export path.
title: Staged Reverse-Tail Carry-Lead Curriculum
